scores.claim_text: IonQ names AFRL as a government customer / partner — IonQ's AFRL trapped-ion / quantum-networking work is the company's flagship DoD program-of-record narrative.
scores.M_value: UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS — primary contractor IonQ Inc; FY22=$13M, FY23=$26M, FY24=$12M (all earmark-funded, never Pentagon-requested), FY25=$0, FY26=$0 (second consecutive unfunded year per FY26 bipartisan budget signed Jan 20 2026). PIID FA8750-22-C-1022 ($13.4M obligated via AFRL Rome FA8750 office).
scores.interpretation: CANONICAL J-BOOK DIVERGENCE. IonQ's marquee federal program-of-record (the AFRL Rome quantum-networking trapped-ion contract) has been zero-funded by the Pentagon for two consecutive fiscal years through the cutoff date — the program was a pure congressional add (earmark) from FY22-FY24 that the Pentagon never requested. Earmark sponsors (Tester-MT, Cardin-MD, Van Hollen-MD, Hoyer-MD) lost majority power after the Nov 2024 election; the FY26 budget did not renew the line (earmark_detector.query_earmark_status returns sponsors_currently_in_power=false / active_in_current_fy=false → EARMARK_SUNSET). Per heuristic 5 (Earmark sub-signal), structurally durable defunding bumps severity up one tier. Per heuristic 6 (USAspending cross-check), the historical contracts WERE real ($13.4M obligated on PIID FA875022C1022 — past revenue real, but forward pipeline is zero), confirming SEVERE at minimum. Combined with materiality (this is the company's only flagship DoD program-of-record and a load-bearing element of the federal-customer narrative), final severity is RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE. 10-K narrates AFRL as a current/forward partner; J-Book + earmark detector say the funding has been gone for two years.

scores.claim_text: IonQ states $370.0M in remaining performance obligations (mix funded + unfunded) and that 'anticipated future revenues from the U.S. government result from contracts awarded under various U.S. government programs.'
scores.M_value: Three IonQ-attributed programs in J-Book: (a) AFRL Quantum Networking — UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, (b) AFRL Qubitekk Quantum Networking — FUNDED_GROWING but small ($12.2M FY26), (c) UMD Quantum (IONQ subcontractor) — UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR. Earmark detector: AFRL QN earmark sponsors lost majority post-Nov 2024; FY25 and FY26 enacted = $0. The 10-K explicitly admits the $370M RPO 'includes unfunded orders' where funding 'has not been appropriated' — those are the J-Book-zeroed lines.
scores.interpretation: The $370M backlog is the most narrative-load-bearing forward number in the filing, but IonQ concedes in plain text that it includes UNFUNDED orders. The two flagship Air Force quantum-networking earmarks (the original IonQ Rome contract and the Qubitekk-acquired ceiling) together total ~$54.5M of bookings where ~$33.5M was unfunded ceiling per the corpus. Pair (b) — the Qubitekk line — is funded and growing modestly ($8.9M→$12.2M); pair (a) — the flagship IonQ AFRL line — is now zero-funded for the second consecutive FY through cutoff. With the ex-CEO and CFO disclosed-discretionary sales clustering on the exact date FY25 appropriations confirmed the zeroing (see C-supplement insider_vs_calendar result), the forward backlog conversion narrative is materially impaired. SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY: the disclosed forward revenue depends on lines the Pentagon J-Book confirms are zeroed.

scores.claim_text: Three customers = 53% of FY2025 revenue; IonQ expects increasing concentration. Two customers = 77% in FY24; two = 58% in FY23.
scores.M_value: USAspending: IonQ Federal LLC = 0 DoD awards under that exact legal name. IonQ Inc = 0 DoD awards under that variant. usaspending.query_federal_presence (name_variants=[IonQ Inc, IonQ Federal LLC, IonQ Quantum Inc]) returns n_ueis_resolved=0, n_contracts=0, signal=INFLATION_SUSPECT. However, Qubitekk Inc (acquired Dec 2024, now IonQ subsidiary) has 8 prior DoD awards = $12.7M total, dominated by FA8750-25-CB-001 AFRL Quantum Network ($8.97M). Capella Space (acquired Jul 2025) has 9 DoD awards = $15.7M total. Per the ticker_pe_crosswalk: IonQ legacy = 33 contracts, $196.5M total.
scores.interpretation: MIXED SIGNAL: (a) Customer concentration is admittedly high and rising, and (b) the federal-government share of that concentration overlaps the J-Book-zeroed AFRL Quantum Networking line, but (c) USAspending under direct IonQ legal variants returns zero — the company books DoD revenue via subsidiaries (Qubitekk Federal LLC, Capella Space Corp.) rather than 'IonQ Federal, LLC' as such. INFLATION_SUSPECT signal from federal_presence supports the view that the parent's federal-customer narrative is more acquisition-dependent than direct. MODERATE because the concentration claim itself is truthful (and disclosed) but the J-Book divergence on the underlying program puts the customer concentration at structural risk if a top-3 customer is the AFRL/AF Rome line whose program is zero-funded.

scores.claim_text: Qubitekk Federal LLC (acquired Dec 2024) is a federal-contracting vehicle for AFRL quantum networking.
scores.M_value: J-Book: AFRL Qubitekk Quantum Networking — status=FUNDED_GROWING (declared FUNDED_STEADY; derived FUNDED_GROWING). FY25=$8.9M, FY26=$12.2M (earmark renewed in FY26 bipartisan budget). Earmark-secured=true but sponsors_currently_in_power not adverse for this specific line; renewed. USAspending: Qubitekk Inc = 8 prior DoD awards = $12.74M total; flagship FA8750-25-CB-001 ($8.97M) labeled 'AFRL QUANTUM NETWORK ... USAF AFRL.'
scores.interpretation: This is the J-Book-positive corner of the IonQ DoD portfolio. The Qubitekk-route AFRL contract IS funded and growing, validating part of the federal-customer narrative. PASS. But note materiality: $12.2M FY26 is small (<10% of FY25 revenue of $130M) vs the parent's $370M RPO, so this funded line cannot rescue the de-funded flagship line in claim C1.

scores.claim_text: Capella Space (IonQ subsidiary) provides SAR data-as-a-service and is pipelined into 'advanced quantum positioning, navigation and timing services.'
scores.M_value: Pentagon J-Book: 'Space Data Network (SDN)' PE 1203636SF matched but primary contractor is SpaceX (Starshield), not Capella; signal=UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR (status_declared=FUNDED_GROWING but corpus history shows FY26=$0 ramping). Per heuristic 4 (PE name ambiguity): Capella's SAR contracts don't map cleanly to a single PE. USAspending: Capella has 9 DoD contracts = $15.72M including FA9453-24-CX-020 'SAR for Government Operations (SARGO)' ($10.0M) and HQ085021C0012 (SDA Tranche 0 Transport Layer demo, $2.97M).
scores.interpretation: The PE match (SDN PE 1203636SF) is a Starshield line, not a Capella line — wrong contractor — so the corpus does not give a clean read on Capella's actual SAR program funding. USAspending confirms ~$15.7M of legitimate Capella DoD revenue across SARGO + SDA Tranche 0, so this is not inflation. The forward PNT claim is speculative and undisclosed in dollar terms. UNVERIFIABLE (heuristic 7) — corpus coverage gap on commercial SAR PEs.

scores.claim_text: IonQ executed 7 acquisitions in ~12 months (ID Quantique, Lightsynq, Capella Space, Oxford Ionics, Vector Atomic, Skyloom, SkyWater-pending).
scores.M_value: Aggregate signal=INCOHERENT_ROLLUP. 4 of 8 acquisitions scored low_coherence with is_revenue_synthetic=true: Capella Space (SAR Earth observation, score 0.05), Vector Atomic (atomic clocks/PNT, 0.35), Skyloom Global (optical inter-sat links, 0.35), SkyWater Technology (semiconductor foundry, 0.15). 4 scored high_coherence (Qubitekk, ID Quantique, Lightsynq, Oxford Ionics).
scores.interpretation: Canonical IonQ-thesis rollup pattern: the parent loses its core federal revenue stream (AFRL Quantum Networking earmark zeroed) and pivots into incoherent acquisitions including a SAR satellite company, a semiconductor foundry, and a laser-comms company — none of which have technology overlap with trapped-ion quantum computing. Per heuristic 'acq_coherence.INCOHERENT_ROLLUP + pentagon_jbook.UNFUNDED' is the highest-precision fraud-pattern combination per the m-source catalog description. RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE: rollup is a textbook revenue-synthetic distraction from a J-Book-zeroed core line.

This is the canonical YSS/IONQ pattern explicitly called out in the m-source catalog description for insider_vs_calendar. Treats as RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE supplementary signal that reinforces claims C1 and C2.
